prompts.name: 01-front-wall.png
prompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: Cuddlecore Kitchen front-wall concept frame for WhiskedAway, a 3D inn cooking website. Deliver ONE 16:9 landscape photograph, not a collage, not a panorama.
Primary request: small square 4.5m x 4.5m English/Kiwi countryside inn kitchen, soft refuge for someone exhausted or unwell. Front wall seen straight-on from room center at 1.6m eye height, full-frame 24mm lens, level verticals, f/4, whole room reasonably sharp.
Front wall: central small cream chipped-enamel vintage range, with ONE distinct dark cast-iron pot simmering on top, lid slightly offset and clear graceful curls of steam catching the window light. Rain-streaked rectangular timber sash window directly above with dusty berry #8b4d5c linen curtains. Beside window a small pinned hand-drawn coastal map on aged paper, absolutely no letters or text.
Same-room layout anchors: left wall has a simple honey-oak open shelf with exactly six distinct jars, below a worn butcher-block counter with a clearly separated group of exactly three lit beeswax candles at different heights. Right wall has a tall cream-painted pantry with one door ajar, food visible, and beside it a small shelf of worn unlabeled cookbooks and blank recipe cards. Show only near edges of these side-wall elements as appropriate; keep front hero pot most inviting. Back wall is behind camera and must not be shown.
Structure: cream limewash #f4efe4, aged exposed oak ceiling beams, worn wide floorboards, restrained old country architecture. Lived-in and intimate, coherent buildable architecture. Small aged brass shaded lamp on right-side counter. Cool soft rainy late-afternoon daylight, warm candlelight and small brass lamp, gentle contrast warm shadows. Natural material imperfections, creased linen, chipped enamel, rubbed wood; editorial cookbook interiors photograph, never polished CGI.
No people, text, labels, letters, logos, watermark, modern appliances/screens, electric cooktop, illustration, fantasy glow, interface overlays, arrows or hotspot markers. Calm uncluttered surfaces; pot, map, jars and candle group easy to distinguish.

prompts.name: 02-left-wall.png
prompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: ONE 16:9 landscape left-wall concept photograph of the SAME Cuddlecore Kitchen in reference image 1. Reference image 1 is authoritative for architecture, room identity, every existing object, textures and illumination. Rotate camera 90 degrees LEFT from that photograph, from room center at 1.6m high, full frame 24mm lens level verticals f/4. Do not redesign room.
Face the left wall straight-on: the existing two simple honey oak shelf planks and same exactly SIX preserving jars (three per shelf) now centered and easy to spot, containing oats, dried herbs, ginger, honey, lentils and mixed pulses. Mix glass jars with cork/cloth lids and one dusty berry ceramic jar; no labels. Below is the same cream worn cabinet with scratched butcher-block counter. Exactly three lit beeswax candles of staggered heights on separate simple saucers form one clear group on counter, generous breathing space. Preserve the existing enamel utensil crock and hanging/trailing herbs but restrained.
The FRONT wall of reference now returns along RIGHT EDGE: show part of the exact same berry curtains, rain-streaked sash window, cream range and dark steaming pot if geometry permits, no new window or range on left wall. Back wall returns along left edge with only a subtle glimpse of chair/door if needed. Cool rainy late-afternoon light arrives from camera-right, existing brass lamp and candles warm the oak, cream #f4efe4 plaster aged beams wide boards and berry #8b4d5c accents match reference. Photographic cookbook editorial realism, wear and chips and creased linen. No text, letters, readable labels, logos, watermark, people, modern appliances, screens, CGI shine or interface overlays. Keep six jars and THREE candles unambiguous.

prompts.name: 03-right-wall.png

The main wall is dominated by the EXACT same tall chipped cream-painted pantry with simple recessed panel doors, aged round brass knobs, one door ajar at same angle, revealing wood shelves with unlabeled bowls, a jar of beans, apples, garlic, folded linen, a wicker basket and a small pumpkin. FRONT wall returns along LEFT EDGE with portion of EXACT same rain-streaked sash window, berry curtains and cream enamel range plus dark cast-iron pot/steam. Front wall pinned map stays in its original position between window and corner. BACK wall returns on right edge with hints of comfortable chair if geometrically appropriate. No second window, no second range, no candle group on this wall. Same cream limewash #f4efe4, exposed aged oak beams, wide worn floorboards and #8b4d5c berry accents. Cool daylight from left, warm lamp pools, rainy late afternoon. Photographic realism for cookbook interiors, natural chips/wear, restraint, no showroom gloss. Pantry and books distinctly separated, uncluttered silhouettes. No people, text, garbled lettering, logos, watermark, modern appliances, screens, illustration, CGI sheen, interface overlays.

prompts.name: 04-back-wall.png
prompts.prompt:

Reverse camera from front view to face opposite wall from room center. Eye height 1.6m full-frame 24mm straight-on level verticals f/4 whole room reasonably sharp.
Back wall main objects: deep LOW comfortably overstuffed armchair in worn warm cream linen at left half, chunky hand-knitted dusty berry #8b4d5c blanket loosely over arm and seat, CAT curled asleep ON a separate soft cream cushion in the chair. Cat anatomically natural, quiet, eyes closed. An old closed oak plank door with simple aged brass handle at right half leads back to inn hallway, clearly distinct and unobstructed, no sign. Berry cream faded-blue woven rag rug under/in front of chair. A small framed botanical watercolor ginger and lemon on cream paper above chair with NO writing. Quiet breathing space between chair and door.
Exact same cream #f4efe4 uneven limewashed plaster, exposed worn oak beams and deep wide old floorboards from references, same room scale. Far LEFT edge can show rear end of right-side cream cupboard/book shelf with PLAIN solid-colored book spines; far RIGHT edge can show end of left butcher-block counter, no duplicate hero objects. Front window and range are BEHIND CAMERA so DO NOT show them on back wall. Cool rainy window fill comes from behind camera; warm light gently spills from existing brass lamp/candles elsewhere, no extra lamp/candle invented. Natural soft warm shadows, editorial cosy-living interiors photo, worn and lived-in without clutter. No people, text, letters, labels, logos, watermarks, screens, modern appliances, CGI sheen, fantasy light, interface.

prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Muted sage land washes, faded blue-gray sea, cream #f4efe4 aged paper with modest foxing and deckle-like fiber texture within image. Warm understated handmade country-inn artwork. ABSOLUTELY NO text, place names, lettering, numbers, compass letters, map keys, symbols resembling words, labels, logos or watermark. Not an actual geographic map.

prompts.name: 12-cable-knit-tile.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: ONE square seamless repeating textile texture, chunky berry-and-cream cable-knit wool for WhiskedAway Cuddlecore room. Orthographic straight-down macro texture, entire square filled by continuous fabric, perfectly flat and evenly lit diffuse neutral illumination. Dusty berry #8b4d5c and cream #f4efe4 alternating cable columns, thick soft wool fibers, natural slight fuzz, consistent stitch scale. Design a TRUE tileable repeat: choose whole repeat units so left/right edges match in pattern/color and top/bottom edges match at same cable twist phase; no seam, edge border, cast shadow, vignette, lighting gradient, folds, fringe, swatch edge, perspective or objects. This is a flat fabric texture, not a room photo and not a product shot. No text, lettering, labels, logos, watermark. Photographic tactile fiber detail, no rendered plastic.

prompts.name: 13-rag-rug-tile.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: ONE square seamless repeating woven rag-rug texture for Cuddlecore kitchen, top-down orthographic flat scan. Entire canvas filled by a close view of flat-woven rag strips in dusty berry #8b4d5c, cream #f4efe4 and faded blue #71828d, horizontal irregular narrow stripes, small visible cross-warp threads, softened cotton fibers, natural modest wear, country handmade rug. Even neutral diffuse illumination with zero directional cast shadows, no folds, no fringe, no edges, no background, no perspective, no vignette or lighting gradient. TRUE seamless square repeat: plan complete stripe repeat so TOP/BOTTOM color+weave phase align, and each woven strip continues identically at LEFT/RIGHT boundary. Tileable on both axes, no border or seam. Texture only, not a room photograph or product shot. No text, labels, lettering, logos, watermark, objects, glossy CGI.

prompts.name: 12-cable-knit-tile.png seam correction
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference is a square wool knit texture edit target. Fix ONLY seamless repetition while keeping the same dusty berry-and-cream cable knit identity and photographic fiber detail. Current image has a visible jump where opposite edges meet. Rebuild as a carefully phase-matched repeat unit: exactly three complete identical berry-and-cream column units across square, each cable with whole-number complete twists vertically. The leftmost and rightmost cut must cross the SAME phase and same color section of berry column; top and bottom cross SAME stitch/twist phase. Match brightness/color/fiber direction at ALL opposite edges, no seam or step or double-thick yarn when tiled. Even flat diffuse lighting across whole tile, no highlights changing near perimeter. Perfect orthographic top-down, no border, no folds, no fringes, no shadow. Texture fills square canvas. No text or objects. This must function as a repeating UV fabric map, not just look like fabric.
